name: Improved Cleaving Finish
body:
General | Combat Stamina

Improved Cleaving Finish (Combat)
Source Ultimate Combat pg. 105
You can cut down many opponents in a single strike.

Prerequisites: Str 13, Cleave, Cleaving Finish, Great Cleave, Power Attack, base attack bonus +6.

Benefit: You can use Cleaving Finish any number of times per round.
Combat Trick (from the Combat Stamina feat)
Source Pathfinder Unchained pg. 122
Once per round when you confirm a critical hit, you can spend 5 stamina points to treat that attack as if you reduced the target to 0 or fewer hit points for the purpose of using the Cleaving FinishUC feat.
